title: Reading ar and or with bossy r

figure.name: x-word
figure.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: When r comes after a vowel, it changes the vowel sound. Look at the car on the board. The word car has 3 letters. It has only 2 sounds.

explain.say: Look at the first letter, c. It makes the first sound in kite. Tap it on your arm.

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: Now look at a and r together. They make one sound, the sound in car and star. Open your mouth wide to say it. Tap 2 times for 2 sounds. Say car, star and park.

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: Now look at o and r together. They make the sound in fork and corn. The word fork has 3 sounds. Tap 3 times and blend to read fork.
Look at the board. The ar words are in one group. The or words are in another group. Which farm animal on the board has or in its name?

faq.a: It is a name for an r that comes after a vowel. The r changes the vowel sound. a and r make the sound in car. o and r make the sound in fork.
ar makes the sound you hear in car, star and park. Open your mouth wide, like at the doctor.
or makes the sound you hear in fork, corn and horse.

faq.q: Does everyone say ar the same way?
faq.a: Not quite. In some places people say the r strongly, and in others it is very soft. Both are right. Say it the way people around you do.
asks: Why does my friend say car differently?

faq.q: How do I spot ar and or when I read?
faq.a: Look for a vowel with an r right after it. Draw a little loop round the two letters, then say them as one sound.
asks: How do I find bossy r?

facts: The word car has three letters but only two sounds.
When r comes after a vowel, as in car and fork, it changes the sound of the vowel.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in the word car?
quiz.show: 🚗 How many sounds are in car?
quiz.why: The c makes 1 sound, and a with r makes 1 sound. That is 2 sounds.

wrong.0: There is the c sound first, then the ar sound.
wrong.2: Car has 3 letters, but a and r make just 1 sound.

quiz.say: Which word has the same vowel sound as fork?
quiz.why: Horse has o and r together. It sounds like the or in fork.

wrong.1: Hat has a short a, as in apple.
wrong.2: Jar has the ar sound, as in car.
